title: New Anvil GUI
description: Returns a new anvil gui. If no title and default text are specified, it will use some placeholder text. If  you choose to specify the name or the text, you have to specify both.
syntax_pattern:
new anvil gui
[a] new anvil gui (named|with title) %string% with [default] text %string%

title: Anvil GUI
description: This type holds all the information about an AnvilGUI inventory. You can create a new object with the new anvil gui expression and edit its content (such as the items) with the specific expressions.
type_usage: This type holds all the information about an AnvilGUI inventory.

title: Anvil GUI Text
description: Access the default text of an AnvilGUI. This will be filled when the anvil is opened to a player.

title: Anvil GUI Title
description: Access the title (inventory name) of an Anvil GUI. In 1.12.2, the name of the AnvilGUI will not change when displayed. This is not really an issue (other than for aesthetic) as the title is still saved and can be accessed (to check for specific anvil GUIs in events).

title: Anvil GUI Close
description: Fires whenever an anvil gui created with this addon is closed. You can access the following values from this event: event-text (content of the GUI when the GUI was closed), event-anvil gui (the original anvil object. You can access items in the anvil GUI or its inventory title with expressions below.)
event_values:
event-text (Text input in the ANVIL)
event-virtual anvil (Original opened anvil)

title: Open Anvil GUI
description: Open an Anvil GUI to a player. Note that once the AnvilGUI is opened to a player, you can't change it "live" while it's being shown. Therefore you first must set the slots of the GUI, and then open it to the player.

title: Anvil GUI Click
description: Fires whenever an anvil gui created with this addon is clicked. You can access the following values from this event: event-integer (index of slot that was clicked), event-text (content of the GUI when the GUI was clicked), event-anvil gui (the original anvil object. You can access items in the anvil GUI or its inventory title with expressions below.)
event_values:
event-integer (ID of clicked slot)
event-text (Text input in the ANVIL)
event-virtual anvil (Original opened anvil)

title: Anvil GUI Slot
description: Access a specific item in the anvil GUI. You can set these to any itemstack. Please note that the server wipes and overwrites the items in the output GUI when opened, so as of right now only changing the left and right item works.
